## Desktop plugins (4)
- [memory-inbox](plugin/memory-inbox/): Desktop inbox for pending memory writes and skill suggestions, with About-you and Nova-notes tabs.
- [session-alerts](plugin/session-alerts/): Session-row badges so new and waiting work is never missed.
- [session-sections](plugin/session-sections/): Drag sessions into nested sidebar sections, project-backed or label-only.
- [usage-dashboard](plugin/usage-dashboard/): Usage chips in the chat UI: model, provider, and spend at a glance.
